feedback_by_option.fil: Halimbawa lang ang listahan; mahalaga ang badyet at ang kaya nilang dalhin.
feedback_by_option.en: A list is an example; their budget and what they can carry matter.

feedback_by_option.fil: Dahil sa sanggol, regular na gamot at expiration, iba ang bag ng pamilyang ito.
feedback_by_option.en: The infant, the regular medicine and expiry make this family's bag different.

feedback_by_option.fil: Hindi pahintulot magbigay ng gamot ang listahan; itanong kung kailangan nila ng tulong sa pagkuha nito.
feedback_by_option.en: The list is not permission to dispense medicine; ask if they need help getting it.

feedback_by_option.fil: Maaaring makapinsala o maantala ang tulong: hindi saklaw ng kinopyang listahan ang kailangan ng pamilyang ito.
feedback_by_option.en: This may harm or delay help: a copied list misses what this family needs.

feedback_by_option.fil: Pinananatiling handa ng petsa ng check ang bag, at nagbubukas ng tulong ang tanong.
feedback_by_option.en: A dated recheck keeps the bag current, and the question opens the way to help.

feedback_by_option.fil: Nag-e-expire ang gamit at nagbabago ang pangangailangan; kailangan ng petsa ng pag-check.
feedback_by_option.en: Items expire and needs change; the bag needs a set recheck date.
